capabilities: Translate selected text via Bing Dictionary, Youdao, or MyMemory in a draggable popover
Show phonetic symbols, part of speech, and exam categories (CET-4, CET-6, IELTS, etc.)
Play word pronunciation automatically or manually with US/UK accents
Let other plugins call getOfficialAPI().lookup(term) for dictionary results
Save looked-up words as vocabulary cards in the Weave plugin
extras: No API key needed; all three supported services are free (MyMemory limited to 1000 requests/day). README includes a developer guide for the lookup API and notes it uses requestUrl() to bypass CORS.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in translation or dictionary lookup, and most translation tools require configuring an API key before use.

summary: Selection-based translation plugin that looks up selected text via Bing Dictionary, Youdao, or MyMemory and shows results with pronunciation.
